summary: Recent updates to the camera and audio capture features in Firefox improve the way the browser handles video frames and recording sessions. **Now, cameras can more effectively adjust their output to match the desired frame rates over time,** ensuring smoother video performance during live interactions. Additionally, when recording a browser window, the device cache is cleared to prevent any potential issues that might arise from using outdated or incorrect data. This enhances the reliability and quality of screen recordings initiated from within the browser.
